title: SigServe one-flag production server
description: The Signature Serve Engine is a Signature original: a high-throughput local inference server where one flag (`sigserve run <model>`) picks parallelism, memory fraction, and quantization automatically from the hardware it detects. It mirrors the familiar OpenAI endpoint shape for compatibility but its scheduler, memory pager, and tuning are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('sigserve run <model>  # auto parallelism + memory + quant')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
sigserve run <model>  # auto parallelism + memory + quant
edition: Signature original

title: SigPage block memory manager
description: SigPage is the Signature block-KV manager: 16-token pages allocated on demand with a buddy allocator for prompt prefixes, plus a defragmentation pass during idle tokens. The design goal is the same as paging (zero fragmentation) with an original allocation algorithm. Signature-original.

demo.program: print('SigPage: 16-token pages, buddy allocator, idle defrag')

title: SigFlow iteration scheduler

title: SigServe auto tensor sharding
description: Instead of a manual parallel-size flag, SigServe measures inter-GPU bandwidth at startup and shards the model to minimize all-reduce time, re-sharding when cards are added. The bandwidth-probing sharder is Signature-original.
